modeValues.mirror: whole-directory mirror: rsync -a --delete (Unix) / robocopy /MIR (Windows). Deletes anything in the destination that is not in the source. Use only for kit-owned directories (dest is a grimoire-kit subpath, e.g. hooks/grimoire-kit).
modeValues.merge: per-child mirror: each immediate child of the source is mirrored separately into dest, so third-party content sitting next to it in the destination home survives. Required for destinations that host non-kit content (skills dirs, hooks dirs).
